build_transformer_layer: build a transformer decoder layer with multi-headed self-attention and feedforward network
create_stacked_transformer: create a stack of transformer layers with configurable dropout, normalization policy, and causal attention
build_attention_pooling: build an attentional token pooling layer that reduces variable-length sequences to fixed-size queries
create_dot_product_attention: create dot-product multi-head attention with query/key/value projections, logit capping, and QK normalization
build_feedforward_layer: build a transformer feedforward layer with residual connections, dropout, and configurable normalization policies
